import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Standardize species labels
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Standardize island labels (strip spaces, title case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Ensure numeric columns are actual numbers (they may be read as strings)
    for col in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins per island (keep penguin_id as unique identifier)
    result = df.groupby('island')['penguin_id'].nunique().to_dict()
    return result
